Messages.Author: Karl and Sam
Messages.Body:
Just a couple of questions

- can you play a discipline card on an uncontrolled Vampire

- are the presses granted by Trap! usable by either minion to continue the combat

- What criteria met by whom will burn the First Tradition Masquerade

- when using flesh to marble can you choose to take whichever point of damage you like as your 1 point
(ie. take 1 normal out of a strike for 2 agg and 3 normal damage.)

Thanks Karl

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <353C7111...@infomatch.com>,

Karl and Sam <in...@infomatch.com> wrote:
>
> Just a couple of questions
>
> - can you play a discipline card on an uncontrolled Vampire

No. Uncontrolled cards (vampires in the uncontrolled region, cards in
your hand, cards in the ash heap, crypt, or library) are not valid targets
for any effects unless explicitly stated on card text.

> - are the presses granted by Trap! usable by either minion to continue
the combat

No, the press is generated by the Trap itself, independent of either minion.
The acting minion then gets first opportunity to press (to end).

> - What criteria met by whom will burn the First Tradition Masquerade

The First tradition is burned when "you" have met some criteria - and "you"
always refers to the controller of the card.

1stTrad is burned when its controller has paid 6 pool in penalties or has
skipped three turns (or is ousted, of course).

> - when using flesh to marble can you choose to take whichever point of
damage you like as your 1 point
> (ie. take 1 normal out of a strike for 2 agg and 3 normal damage.)

Yes.

--

>Yes.

Of course, His Ruleness means Flesh of Marble (superior), since the
inferior cannot prevent aggravated damage.

The ruling does still apply at inferior in the case of
regular damage with a nasty side effect, such as the Jyhad Stake.
